ATX Full Moon Cruise

Austin, TX · Downtown · Social

ATX Full Moon Cruise is a social group ride in Austin, TX. It rolls monthly, on a Friday at 11:30 am from Pfluger Pedestrian Bridge. Pace: social; a different route each month.

For visitors

Unsupported and ride at your own risk. Don't arrive later than 11:30 pm. Bring lights, tools to fix a flat, water and a phone. The group tries not to drop slow riders but it can happen. If it rains they may gather under the circle instead. Details and reminders are in the group's Facebook group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social; a different route each month.
Check
Look at @fullmooncruise the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the ATX Full Moon Cruise group ride

A monthly late-night social ride that leaves the Pfluger Pedestrian Bridge near midnight on the weekend night closest to the full moon, on a different route each month. There is also an annual ride in September at 2:00 am.
